name: Exp_AML
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorAML custom indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator signals an uptrend (value=2) and sell positions when it signals a downtrend (value=0). It uses configurable lot sizing, stop loss, and take profit levels, with permission switches for each trade direction and position closing. The strategy operates on a multi-timeframe basis, running the indicator on a user-specified timeframe while executing on the chart timeframe.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorAML自定义指标进行交易，当指标发出上升趋势信号(值=2)时开多仓，发出下降趋势信号(值=0)时开空仓。它使用可配置的手数、止损和止盈水平，并为每个交易方向和平仓操作提供独立的权限开关。策略支持多周期运行，指标在用户指定的时间周期上计算。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于ColorAML指标的趋势跟踪系统。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区1在信号栏的值为2且前一栏值不为2时开多仓；当值为0且前一栏值不为0时开空仓，这种条件确保只在趋势转换时入场而非趋势延续中重复开仓。出场条件包括止损和止盈的固定点数设置，以及反向信号触发时平仓（如出现下降趋势信号时平掉多头仓位）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值代表固定手数，正值代表按存款比例计算手数。资金管理依赖外部包含文件TradeAlgorithms.mqh中的函数实现，没有内建的资金管理逻辑。该策略在每根新K线出现时检测信号，避免逐tick重复计算，同时使用IsNewBar机制防止重复开仓。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a trend-following system based on the ColorAML custom indicator. Entry conditions are: a buy position opens when indicator buffer 1 at the signal bar equals 2 and the previous bar's value is not 2, ensuring entries only occur on trend transitions rather than during ongoing trends. Sell positions open when the value is 0 and the previous bar is not 0, applying the same transition logic. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit in points, as well as closing positions on reverse signals (e.g., closing longs when a downtrend signal appears). Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit-proportional sizing. Money management is delegated to external functions in the TradeAlgorithms.mqh include file, with no built-in money management logic visible in the EA itself. The strategy detects signals only on new bar formations to avoid per-tick redundant calculations, and uses the IsNewBar mechanism to prevent duplicate position openings.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 仓位比例或固定手数，负值为手数，正值为存款比例
parameters.description_en: Trade share or lot; negative value=fixed lots

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格偏差点数（滑点容忍度）
parameters.description_en: Max price deviation in points (slippage tolerance)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 具有明确的趋势转换入场逻辑，避免在趋势延续中重复开仓
提供灵活的仓位管理参数，支持固定手数和按存款比例两种模式
为开仓和平仓分别设置权限开关，便于精细控制交易行为
使用新K线检测机制，避免逐tick重复计算和信号抖动
止损和止盈参数明确，具有基本的风险控制框架
pros_en: Clear trend-transition entry logic that avoids duplicate entries during ongoing trends
Flexible position sizing parameter supporting both fixed lots and deposit-proportional modes
Separate permission switches for opening and closing positions in each direction enable fine-grained control
New bar detection mechanism prevents per-tick redundant calculations and signal flickering
Explicit stop loss and take profit parameters provide a basic risk control framework
cons: 依赖外部包含文件TradeAlgorithms.mqh的核心交易逻辑，无法独立评估交易执行质量
没有点差过滤机制，在H4周期影响较小但如果切换到短周期可能产生滑点损失
ColorAML指标为自定义指标，不在标准MT5安装中，缺少指标时EA无法运行且错误处理仅打印日志
没有持仓检查逻辑，可能在已有同方向持仓时重复开仓
止损止盈为固定点数，未考虑市场波动率（ATR）动态调整
cons_en: Core trading logic depends on external include file TradeAlgorithms.mqh, making it impossible to independently evaluate trade execution quality
No spread filter mechanism; while less impactful on H4, switching to shorter timeframes could lead to slippage losses
ColorAML is a custom indicator not included in standard MT5 installations; missing indicator causes EA failure with only a log print as error handling
No position check logic; may open duplicate positions in the same direction if one already exists
Stop loss and take profit are fixed point values without ATR-based dynamic adjustment for market volatility
improvements: 增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓，或在开仓前检查当前持仓状态
将止损止盈改为基于ATR的动态计算，以适应不同市场波动环境
增加自定义指标句柄获取失败时的健壮错误处理（如停止EA运行或重试机制）
增加点差过滤和交易时间过滤，提高执行质量
improvements_en: Add position check logic to avoid duplicate entries in the same direction, or check current positions before opening new ones
Convert stop loss and take profit to ATR-based dynamic calculation to adapt to different market volatility environments
Add robust error handling when custom indicator handle acquisition fails (e.g., stop EA execution or implement retry mechanism)
Add spread filter and trading session filter to improve execution quality

risk_points: 依赖外部包含文件TradeAlgorithms.mqh，其交易执行逻辑未经审计，可能存在未知的仓位管理缺陷
没有持仓方向和数量检查，可能导致同方向重复开仓造成过度暴露
指标句柄获取失败时EA继续运行但无法产生信号，可能导致错过交易机会或异常行为
risk_points_en: Dependency on external include file TradeAlgorithms.mqh whose trade execution logic is unaudited and may contain unknown position management flaws
No position direction or count check may lead to duplicate same-direction entries causing overexposure
EA continues running when indicator handle acquisition fails but cannot generate signals, potentially missing trading opportunities or behaving unexpectedly
